intro.title: WebSockets with Express
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a real-time chat application using WebSockets with Express. You will learn how to establish a persistent, two-way communication channel between a client and server, enabling instant message updates without page reloads. The core programming concept involves handling WebSocket connections, events, and broadcasting messages to multiple clients. You will use the Express framework to set up the server and the 'ws' library to implement WebSocket functionality. This hands-on project will help you understand how real-time features work in modern web applications.
intro.usecase: WebSockets enable real-time, bidirectional communication between clients and servers, making them essential for interactive applications. In real-world software, you'll see WebSockets powering live chat applications like Slack or Discord, where messages appear instantly without page refreshes. They're also crucial for collaborative tools like Google Docs, where multiple users can edit simultaneously and see each other's changes in real-time. Additionally, WebSockets drive live dashboards for stock trading platforms, sports score trackers, and IoT device monitoring systems that require constant data updates. As a developer, implementing WebSockets in Express allows you to build responsive, engaging applications that feel immediate and interactive to users.
